metrics.investment_case_interpretation: market_cap / discounted_sustainable_net_profit is about 9.74 years, within the <=15 threshold for profit_cheap. Because conservative net detachable cash is negative after cash haircuts, bank debt, operating cash reserve and friction reserve, the owner earnback on operating business price is about 10.52 years.

profit_quality.assessment: Usable but not pristine. 2022-2023 operating cash flow was strong, yet publishing requires large recurring pre-publication/title investment and 2021 cash conversion was much weaker. The main profit base is parent-attributable earnings, with bank interest from detachable cash stripped out to avoid double counting.
adjustments: Used 2023 parent net profit HKD 185.248m as the central earnings base because it equals the three-year median of 2021-2023 parent net profit.
Deducted 2023 bank interest income HKD 24.045m because the related cash is partly treated as detachable in net cash.
Treated PPE purchases plus pre-publication additions as recurring reinvestment pressure when assigning a 0.75 cash profit haircut.
Did not add back prior-year associate disposal gain or impairment reversals as sustainable profit.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Group operating cash flow was HKD 484.663m in 2023 and HKD 512.510m in 2022; after PPE capex and pre-publication additions, 2023 cash left was about HKD 271.394m at group level before NCI/financing/distributions.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 0.75 reflects positive recent cash conversion but recurring title investment, multinational subsidiary/NCI structure and one weak 2021 cash year.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year operating cash conversion is acceptable in 2022-2023 but volatile over 2021-2023.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: PPE capex and pre-publication additions are treated together as recurring reinvestment pressure because maintenance/growth split is not disclosed.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 working capital changes were modestly negative overall; 2022 benefited from large receivable release, so best year is not used to inflate the denominator.

limitations: Cash is not split by parent/company ownership chain; detachable cash therefore uses a conservative group-level haircut.
The analysis uses 2024-05-23 historical market cap from input, not current market cap.
Maintenance versus growth split of capex and pre-publication investment is not disclosed; denominator uses a haircut rather than a precise maintenance capex schedule.
